scope: Read-only frozen derived map geometry review for Sincere / 先施公司 at 南京东路690号 (sh-historic-b1-013), including identity exclusion of Old/New Wing On, Sun Sun, The Sun, and the unrelated former East Asia Bank. No historical-boundary, façade-orientation, survey or model/geographic acceptance.

source.read_method: git show of existing object with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; no network or original OSM query
source.status: Locally frozen derived candidate audit GeoJSON, not original OSM geometry response

identity.conclusion: One listed place and one frozen named map feature bind these historical/use names. These names are not evidence of three independent buildings. No explicit map subdivision assigns hotel, department store, tower, annex or floor level.
identity.qualification: One named coarse envelope is not proof that all historical accommodation, retail and later wings form one indivisible historical structure. Detailed boundaries still require documentary/photo evidence.
identity.shanghai_fashion_store_wording: The requested 上海时装商店 wording is not a literal alias in these frozen indexed records, which say 时装公司. Treat its exact historical/current naming as a documentary crosscheck rather than inventing a second mapped building.
identity.wrong_east_asia_name_exclusion: 东亚大楼 / Former East Asia Bank is a separate named building at 四川中路299号, sh-historic-b3-018, year1926, map999713d3-cd98-4f6a-a77e-59ec850952c0 / OSMw493784118@4. It is not the 东亚饭店 alias attached to Sincere.

method.basis: Same WGS84 ECEF-to-local-ENU metric method as extract_heritage_footprints.py, adapted to six reviewed feature identities.
method.coordinate_transform: WGS84 longitude/latitude at ellipsoid height zero to ECEF, then tangent-plane east and north at each polygon centroid
method.axes: x east, y north, metres; local tangent-plane map measurements, not survey precision
method.dimensions: ENU axis-aligned bounds and GEOS minimum rotated rectangle. Bearing clockwise from north modulo180 is not verified front/façade orientation.
method.neighbors: Only existing audit-index features with polygon distance under65m. Conservative coordinate-bbox prefilter expands each reviewed polygon bbox by0.001degree in each direction; it retains large polygons whose centroids fall outside the neighborhood. No indexed feature is unioned into another. The candidate index is not a complete city inventory.
method.cross_subject_distances: Pairwise and target-relative distances use Sincere centroid ENU plane; minor area differences from per-feature measurements reflect different tangent-plane origins.
method.independent_check: Shoelace exterior area agrees with GEOS area within1e-7m² for each reviewed polygon.
